Requirement 1 AC1.criterion: GIVEN empty, binary, multi-buffer and multi-entry included payloads, WHEN restored, THEN bytes, entry boundaries, notifications and read-only destination behavior SHALL remain compatible; read/write/close failures SHALL remain observable.

Requirement 1 AC2.criterion: GIVEN empty and nonempty archive payloads with injected read, write or close failures, WHEN the enclosing document restore runs, THEN the approved compatibility policy SHALL define diagnostic/failure-list state, partial destination disposition, property notifications and continued restoration of later entries.

Requirement 1 AC3.criterion: GIVEN a failed first registered entry followed by a valid second entry, WHEN opening the archive, THEN the expected second-entry bytes and document-level failure outcome SHALL be verified rather than inferred from a property-hook exception.

Requirement 2 AC1.criterion: GIVEN RGB32, ARGB32, RGBA8888, RGBX8888, premultiplied, indexed, grayscale, high-depth and SVG-derived inputs, WHEN converted and displayed, THEN orientation, color, alpha, scale and texture ownership SHALL match the baseline.

Requirement 2 AC2.criterion: BEFORE conversion or Coin allocation, THE converter SHALL validate non-null input, supported positive dimensions representable by the destination type, and checked allocation/offset arithmetic; unsupported extents SHALL follow a documented failure result without partial writes or memory access outside the destination.

Requirement 2 AC3.criterion: GIVEN direct and fallback images at the supported extent boundary and slender images with dimensions 32767, 32768 and 65537, WHEN converted, THEN supported cases SHALL retain correct pixels and unsupported cases SHALL be rejected safely; null input SHALL have an explicit tested outcome.

Requirement 3 AC1.criterion: WHEN an optimization is proposed for review, THE evidence SHALL identify baseline/current revisions, build mode, fixture, run count, cold/warm policy, before/after timings and focused correctness checks.

Requirement 3 AC2.criterion: BEFORE correctness or measurement results are accepted, THE evidence SHALL identify candidate source/dependency revisions, binary/build provenance, platform, toolchain and fixture identity in the validation manifest; evidence from existing unpinned binaries SHALL remain historical.

Requirement 3 AC3.criterion: BEFORE performance samples are collected for acceptance, THE protocol SHALL define primary fixtures/metrics, timing endpoints, run count, statistic, warm-up/exclusion policy, variability treatment and improvement/non-regression decision rules; each production optimization SHALL have assigned comparative evidence or an explicit reviewed exclusion/routed disposition.

Requirement 3 AC4.criterion: WHEN deferred image work is evaluated, THE measurements SHALL distinguish command-mode restore, GUI open-to-first-correct-frame, hidden-first-show-to-correct-frame and repeat-show latency, initial visibility, pending/materialized texture counts, and peak process/decoded/Coin image bytes; deferred work SHALL be reported separately from eliminated work.

Requirement 3 AC5.criterion: WHEN source, dependency, build, fixture or relevant environment changes affect evidence applicability, THE final review SHALL rerun affected automated, archive, calibration/lifecycle, visual/manual and benchmark checks or record a reviewed equivalence justification tied to the exact final revisions; assembling old timings alone SHALL NOT satisfy acceptance.

Requirement 3 AC6.criterion: WHEN lifecycle decision discovery is queried, THE package SHALL expose all still-open D001–D007 decisions with accurate status, owner and blocking tasks; context-packet availability SHALL NOT authorize execution over unresolved decisions or task dependencies.

Requirement 3 AC7.criterion: WHEN performance trade-offs are accepted, THE review SHALL apply D007 and record absolute/relative benefits, confidence and tails, workflow frequency, transient versus retained memory/process peaks, concurrency/operating scope, rationale, mitigation and owner. Numeric investigation thresholds SHALL trigger review rather than automatically vetoing a useful optimization; safety/fidelity, model identity, error visibility, provenance and required coverage SHALL remain mandatory independently of performance benefit.

Requirement 3 AC8.criterion: WHEN policy changes after results are observed, THE package SHALL preserve the original protocol/results/classifications and label any secondary cost-benefit judgment as retrospective. Future sampling SHALL bind the current review policy before execution; pure policy changes SHALL NOT require repeating complete qualified measurements solely to clear old numeric vetoes. Evidence-applicability changes SHALL retain AC5's requalification/equivalence obligation.

Requirement 4 AC1.criterion: WHEN existing dot-separated element-map entries are restored, THE parser SHALL preserve names, child string IDs and map semantics without changing the archive format.

Requirement 4 AC2.criterion: WHEN numeric archive tokens are parsed, THE implementation SHALL avoid signed overflow and out-of-bounds access and document accepted/rejected behavior for decimal/hexadecimal limits, signs, prefixes, whitespace, invalid suffixes and oversized tokens, preserving legacy tolerance unless an intentional compatibility change is approved.

Requirement 4 AC3.criterion: GIVEN fixtures for semicolon, colon and hashed dollar-prefix forms, decimal child IDs and hexadecimal mapped IDs above nine, multiple SIDs/aliases and nested/shared child maps, WHEN saved/restored/saved, THEN semantic identity and mapped-to-indexed/indexed-to-mapped lookups SHALL remain equivalent after input storage is released.

Requirement 4 AC4.criterion: GIVEN a saved CAD document with features referencing dependent subelements, WHEN reopened and recomputed after parser changes, THEN those references SHALL retain their intended targets; byte-identical serialization SHALL be required only where the format promises deterministic ordering.

Requirement 5 AC1.criterion: WHILE restore-time image payloads are unavailable, THE view provider SHALL defer loading.

Requirement 5 AC2.criterion: WHEN restore completes for a visible image plane or a hidden plane is shown, THE pending original full-resolution texture SHALL materialize while preserving source image and plane dimensions.

Requirement 5 AC3.criterion: GIVEN visible and hidden image planes with stored XSize and YSize independently calibrated away from image DPI defaults, WHEN reopened, first shown and saved/reopened again, THEN stored dimensions, placement and original texture resolution SHALL remain unchanged; hidden copy/paste/import followed by later show SHALL preserve the same calibration.

Requirement 5 AC4.criterion: WHEN a pending original texture is materialized, THE texture-load operation SHALL preserve existing calibration independently of transient GUI restoring or App importing flags; fresh image insertion or explicit user resize SHALL retain its documented sizing behavior.

Requirement 6 AC1.criterion: WHILE a document is restoring, THE tree SHALL retain one pending status update and flush it after document open.

Requirement 6 AC2.criterion: WHEN objects are deleted, THE tree SHALL preserve per-object selection, focus, child and map side effects; a bulk-delete bypass requires separate evidence and design.

Requirement 6 AC3.criterion: WHEN a tree widget is destroyed or recreated while the application remains alive, THEN its application subscriptions and queued callbacks SHALL end with receiver lifetime; a later document-open signal SHALL NOT access the destroyed widget.

Requirement 6 AC4.criterion: GIVEN idle tree timers, WHEN application open, direct document load/restore, import or copy/paste enters a suppressed restore path, THEN a matching completion or safely resumed scheduler SHALL eventually populate/status the tree and attach observers without another edit or document open; completion/error cleanup SHALL NOT strand pending work.
